scripts.name: Verify protected Build 29 recovery source
scripts.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Reviewed forward inputs are externally provisioned job variables/files;
# never inferred from an APK, acceptance JSON, branch or build number.
# BEGIN custodial_forward_input_transport
# The two existing official inputs select an independently hash-pinned
# metadata-only Git ref. No new credential, workflow input or Source checkout.
if [ -n "${MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS_SHA256:-}" ] \
    && [ -n "${MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_ROLE:-}" ] \
    && ! declare -p MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_SOURCE_INPUT >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && ! declare -p MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  custodial_transport_paths="$(node mobile/scripts/provision-custodial-forward-build-inputs.mjs \
    --root "$CM_BUILD_DIR" \
    --pins-sha256 "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS_SHA256" \
    --role "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_ROLE" \
    --environment-output "$CM_ENV")"
  custodial_transport_source_seen=0
  custodial_transport_pins_seen=0
  while IFS= read -r custodial_transport_line; do
    case "$custodial_transport_line" in
      MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_SOURCE_INPUT=/*)
        test "$custodial_transport_source_seen" -eq 0
        export MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_SOURCE_INPUT="${custodial_transport_line#*=}"
        custodial_transport_source_seen=1
        ;;
      MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS=/*)
        test "$custodial_transport_pins_seen" -eq 0
        export MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS="${custodial_transport_line#*=}"
        custodial_transport_pins_seen=1
        ;;
      *) printf 'Unexpected forward input transport output\n' >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
  done <<< "$custodial_transport_paths"
  test "$custodial_transport_source_seen" -eq 1
  test "$custodial_transport_pins_seen" -eq 1
fi
# END custodial_forward_input_transport
# BEGIN custodial_forward_arguments
custodial_forward_args=()
custodial_forward_count=0
custodial_forward_pair_count=0
for custodial_forward_name in MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS_SHA256 MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_ROLE; do
  if declare -p "$custodial_forward_name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    custodial_forward_pair_count=$((custodial_forward_pair_count + 1))
  fi
done
test "$custodial_forward_pair_count" -eq 0 || test "$custodial_forward_pair_count" -eq 2
if [ -z "${MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS_SHA256:-}" ] \
    && [ -z "${MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_ROLE:-}" ]; then
  # Absent/both-empty DECLARED inputs are legacy, never a review.
  # Provisioned forward file paths without that pair are incomplete.
  if declare -p MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_SOURCE_INPUT >/dev/null 2>&1 \
      || declare -p MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'Forward file paths require nonempty declared review inputs\n' >&2; exit 1
  fi
else
  test "${MZ_APP_EDITION:-}" = custodial
  for custodial_forward_name in \
    MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_SOURCE_INPUT MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS \
    MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS_SHA256 MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_ROLE; do
    declare -p "$custodial_forward_name" >/dev/null 2>&1
    test -n "${!custodial_forward_name}" || { printf 'Empty reviewed forward input: %s\n' "$custodial_forward_name" >&2; exit 1; }
    custodial_forward_count=$((custodial_forward_count + 1))
  done
  test "$custodial_forward_count" -eq 4
  [[ "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
  [[ "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_ROLE" = candidate || "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_ROLE" = recovery ]]
  [[ "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_SOURCE_INPUT" = /* && "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS" = /* ]]
  test "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_SOURCE_INPUT" != "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS"
  custodial_forward_args=(
    --forward-source-input "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_SOURCE_INPUT"
    --forward-trusted-pins "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS"
    --forward-trusted-pins-sha256 "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_TRUSTED_PINS_SHA256"
    --forward-role "$MZ_CUSTODIAL_FORWARD_ROLE"
  )
fi
readonly -a custodial_forward_args
# END custodial_forward_arguments
if [ "$custodial_forward_count" -ne 0 ]; then
  # BEGIN custodial_reviewed_forward_build_number
  # Select DATA only from the existing externally pinned role reader.
  # The unchanged private source admission below must still succeed.
  custodial_reviewed_build_number="$(node --input-type=module - "${custodial_forward_args[@]}" <<'NODE'
import { parseForwardBuildArguments, readReviewedForwardBuildSourceSelection }
  from './mobile/scripts/configure-native-release.mjs';
const selection = await readReviewedForwardBuildSourceSelection(parseForwardBuildArguments(process.argv.slice(2)));
if (selection === null) throw new Error('Reviewed forward build role selection is required');
process.stdout.write(String(selection.version_code));
NODE
  )"
  [[ "$custodial_reviewed_build_number" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
  export PROJECT_BUILD_NUMBER="$custodial_reviewed_build_number"
  # END custodial_reviewed_forward_build_number
  # Observe genuine named clean source/review/private brand before effects.
  # No checkout/reset/symbolic-ref substitute for the actual CI source.
  node --input-type=module - "${custodial_forward_args[@]}" <<'NODE'
import {
  assertReviewedForwardBuild, loadReviewedForwardBuild,
  parseForwardBuildArguments, resolveBuildNumber,
} from './mobile/scripts/configure-native-release.mjs';
const flags = parseForwardBuildArguments(process.argv.slice(2));
const build = resolveBuildNumber(process.env);
const context = await loadReviewedForwardBuild(flags, { buildNumber: build.numeric });
const descriptor = assertReviewedForwardBuild(context, {
  buildNumber: build.numeric, sourceCommit: process.env.CM_COMMIT,
  sourceRef: 'refs/heads/' + process.env.CM_BRANCH,
});
if (process.env.CM_COMMIT !== descriptor.source.commit
    || process.env.CM_BRANCH !== descriptor.source.ref.slice('refs/heads/'.length)) {
  throw new Error('Codemagic source identity differs from the owner-reviewed forward role');
}
NODE
  git check-ref-format "refs/heads/$CM_BRANCH"
  git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin \
    "+refs/heads/$CM_BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$CM_BRANCH"
  test "$(git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$CM_BRANCH")" = "$CM_COMMIT"
  # BEGIN custodial_reviewed_forward_build_number_export
  # Later normal configure/provenance/verifier steps consume this value.
  : "${CM_ENV:?Codemagic environment output path is required}"
  printf 'PROJECT_BUILD_NUMBER=%s\n' "$PROJECT_BUILD_NUMBER" >> "$CM_ENV"
  # END custodial_reviewed_forward_build_number_export
else
  recovery_branch='release/custodial-build29-recovery-v53-implementation-20260918'
  test "${CM_BRANCH:-}" = "$recovery_branch"
  test "${CM_COMMIT:-}" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin \
    "+refs/heads/$recovery_branch:refs/remotes/origin/$recovery_branch"
  test "$(git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$recovery_branch")" = "$CM_COMMIT"
  printf 'Protected Build 29 recovery source verified: %s at %s\n' \
    "$recovery_branch" \
    "$CM_COMMIT"
fi

scripts.name: Attest exact tracked source after native build
scripts.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
actual_commit="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
expected_tree="$(git rev-parse "$CM_COMMIT^{tree}")"
index_tree="$(git write-tree)"
source_status="$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
if [ "$actual_commit" != "$CM_COMMIT" ] || \
  [ "$expected_tree" != "$index_tree" ] || \
  [ -n "$source_status" ]; then
  printf \
    'Source attestation failed: expected commit %s, actual commit %s.\n' \
    "$CM_COMMIT" \
    "$actual_commit" \
    >&2
  if [ -n "$source_status" ]; then
    printf 'Dirty source paths (status only):\n%s\n' "$source_status" >&2
  fi
  exit 1
fi
SOURCE_TREE="$expected_tree" node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
writeFileSync(
  `build/provenance/${process.env.MZ_APP_EDITION}-source-attestation.json`,
  `${JSON.stringify({
    schema_version: 1,
    source_commit: process.env.CM_COMMIT,
    source_tree: process.env.SOURCE_TREE,
    source_ref: process.env.CM_BRANCH,
    tracked_worktree_clean: true,
    untracked_nonignored_files_absent: true,
  }, null, 2)}\n`,
  { flag: 'wx' },
);
NODE
